content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free service that allows you to host static websites directly from a GitHub repository. This is particularly significant for digital creators who want to sell products online without the exorbitant fees associated with traditional platforms. Unlike Gumroad, which charges a 10% fee per sale, a digital store on GitHub Pages using NOWPayments for crypto processing incurs only a 0.5% fee. This difference means that for creators making 100 sales a month at $97 each, they would retain an additional $921 simply by using GitHub Pages instead of a platform like Gumroad.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages store is straightforward yet powerful. It utilizes GitHub for hosting, which means your store is live and accessible without costs. Google Apps Script can handle backend logic, automating processes like order confirmation and product delivery. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly for crypto payment processing, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This setup ensures that you maintain full control over your store, data, and customer interactions, creating an efficient digital commerce experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in regions where financial services are limited or inaccessible. If you're an author selling ebooks, an educator offering online courses, or a designer selling templates, GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments offers a sovereign solution. You can sell directly to your customers without relying on third-party platforms that often impose hefty fees or restrictive policies. By using this stack, you ensure that your income remains yours, making it a viable option for those looking to thrive in challenging financial landscapes.
GitHub Pages offers a free hosting solution for your store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of a GitHub Pages store lies in its components working harmoniously. First, GitHub Pages serves as the hosting platform, providing a reliable and free space for your website. Google Apps Script manages backend processes such as order handling and automated emails. For payment processing, NOWPayments enables seamless transactions using cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for traditional banking methods. Together, these elements create a streamlined experience for both creators and customers, ensuring that every aspect of the sale process is efficient and cost-effective.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying your GitHub Pages digital store, first, create a GitHub account and set up your repository. Next, upload your product files and write the necessary HTML for your storefront. Then, configure Google Apps Script to handle order management and notifications. Integrate NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept payments securely. Finally, launch your store and promote it through your networks. By following these steps, you’ll have a functional digital store up and running in no time, all while maintaining full ownership of your assets.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
NOWPayments ensures minimal transaction fees, maximizing your profits.

This post connects directly to searches about selling digital products without platform fees. If you're looking for a solution to host your digital download store without relying on traditional payment processors, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack at $97. It provides a complete setup with GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments for seamless payment processing. Explore your options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
